claim: Fix \(0<p<1/2\), put \(q=1-p\), and consider the nondestructive qubit measurement with Kraus operators \(V_+=\operatorname{diag}(\sqrt q,\sqrt p)\) and \(V_-=\operatorname{diag}(\sqrt p,\sqrt q)\), the sharpness family used by Janssens. For any integer \(m\ge1\), repeat this same measurement and stop at the first time the outcome score \(S_n=N_+(n)-N_-(n)\) reaches \(+m\) or \(-m\), declaring the sign reached. After forgetting the full stopped record but retaining its declared sign, the resulting two-outcome instrument is exactly the same sharp family with renormalized error parameter \[p_m=\frac{p^m}{p^m+q^m},\qquad \frac{p_m}{1-p_m}=\left(\frac pq\right)^m.\] Equivalently it has effective Kraus operators \(W_+=\operatorname{diag}(\sqrt{1-p_m},\sqrt{p_m})\) and \(W_-=\operatorname{diag}(\sqrt{p_m},\sqrt{1-p_m})\). Hence its measurement infidelity is exactly \(p_m\), its residual coherence multiplier is \(2\sqrt{p_m(1-p_m)}\), and its maximal disturbance is \(1/2-\sqrt{p_m(1-p_m)}\); therefore the adaptive stopped measurement again attains both sharp Janssens information–disturbance/decoherence bounds for every \(m\). The mean number of elementary measurements is \[\mathbb E\tau_m=\frac{m}{q-p}\,\frac{q^m-p^m}{q^m+p^m}.\] Thus this extremal nondestructive family is closed under symmetric likelihood-ratio stopping, with log-odds multiplied exactly by the stopping threshold.
scientific_integrity: The result is proved analytically from gambler's-ruin equations and proportional stopped-path Kraus operators. Finite exact-rational computations are supplementary checks, not substitutes for the proof. Literature searches establish comparison evidence but do not constitute a proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the symmetric two-outcome diagonal nondestructive qubit instrument and symmetric integer score boundaries. It does not cover asymmetric detectors, destructive state transitions, arbitrary sequential instruments, or optimality of expected stopping time over all protocols.
title: Likelihood-ratio stopping preserves the sharp qubit information–disturbance frontier
